title: Tangent projection of a hypersurface of A₀: P_x = Π_{A₀} − ν(x)⊗ν(x), hence continuous on M
statement: Tangent projection of a hypersurface in A₀. Data: P, m ∈ ℕ; a linear subspace A₀ ⊆ ℝ^P; M ⊆ ℝ^P; ν : ℝ^P → ℝ^P. Hypotheses: dim A₀ = m + 1; M ⊆ A₀; M is an embedded C¹ m-dimensional submanifold of ℝ^P (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M); for every x ∈ M, ν(x) ∈ A₀, |ν(x)| = 1 and ν(x)·v = 0 for every v ∈ tangentSpace M x. Conclusion: (i) for every x ∈ M and u ∈ ℝ^P, P_x u = Π u − (ν(x)·u)ν(x), where P_x is the orthogonal projection onto span(tangentSpace M x) and Π the orthogonal projection onto A₀ (both Submodule.starProjection); (ii) if moreover ν is continuous on M, then x ↦ P_x u is continuous on M for every u ∈ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → (∀ x ∈ M, ν x ∈ A₀ ∧ ‖ν x‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (ν x) v = 0) → (∀ x ∈ M, ∀ u : Euclid P, (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection u = A₀.starProjection u - inner ℝ (ν x) u • ν x) ∧ (ContinuousOn ν M → ∀ u : Euclid P, ContinuousOn (fun x => (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection u) M)
